unknown_capacity.rule: Only the validation-ranked first proposal is carried into the unknown-boundary comparison; no formal reward ranking chooses it.

shifted_foundations.interpretation: Separate domain-generator and independently initialized W0 stress test; not a standard SOTA benchmark.

parent_recycle_validation.rule: Compare both paired variants on validation online signed reward; all outcomes retained. The independent capacity cohorts are not used for threshold selection.

parent_recycle_formal.rule: Run only if parent-recycle validation improves at least one method in mean online reward; preserve its fixed-parent control and report all three paired formal seeds.
